§6Pure Crystals§f are refined quartz variants needed for advanced AE2 components. There are three types:

§6Pure Certus Quartz Crystal§f (material:10): required for §6Formation Cores§f and §6P2P Tunnels§f. §6Pure Nether Quartz Crystal§f (material:11): required for §6Engineering Processor§f variants. §6Pure Fluix Crystal§f (material:12): used in high-tier crafting recipes.

They are produced by growing quartz buds in a §6Crystal Growth Accelerator§f, which speeds up the natural growth process. This is the only way to obtain them in bulk.

§ePS:§f Automate with an §6Import Bus§f feeding buds into the accelerator and an §6Export Bus§f extracting grown crystals. The accelerator needs §bAE power§f to function.
